critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/catalog.py PUT /admin/categories does a $set on the whole body which is fine, but response is returned via find_one directly — good; not vulnerable to _id leak (excluded).

Frontend SEO is 100% client-rendered — this is acceptable for Google (JS rendering) but WhatsApp/Facebook/LinkedIn crawlers will NOT execute JS and will see empty og:tags. Consider SSR/prerender or a fallback in index.html for share previews (out of P0 scope, but worth flagging).
SeoGlobals + per-page SEO both inject Organization/WebSite JSON-LD on '/' — dedupe recommended.
